{"baseRefName":"main","body":"Adds four portable English skills for requirements/design, implementation planning, staged development and delivery. Local, understood changes can use a short combined note and document review; consequential changes retain the relevant risk analysis; uncertain work starts with bounded investigation. Plans describe outcomes, dependencies and acceptance without duplicating code/tests.

Start with the [usage guide](https://github.com/tkua2046/coding-agent-skills/blob/codex/workflow-canary/README.md), [goal-to-case contract](https://github.com/tkua2046/coding-agent-skills/blob/codex/workflow-canary/evals/GOALS.md), and [actual results with generated examples](https://github.com/tkua2046/coding-agent-skills/blob/codex/workflow-canary/docs/validation/canary/INDEX.md). Original requirements, research sources, all model attempts, generated files, execution records and review findings are retained. Raw validation files are marked for default collapse in GitHub diffs; direct file links and local review remain available.

Validation:

- Actual final skill cases: 12 pass, 3 fail, 1 inconclusive, 1 deferred. Compatible previous-version trials and every original attempt remain linked.
- Two targeted repairs have supporting evidence: current design/plan scope after an extension, and truthful check claims in setup handoffs. Independent global/result review is complete.
- The complete local hook gate passed with 187 mechanical tests and 92% tools coverage. These tests check packaging/evaluator mechanics, not skill quality.

This remains a draft for owner review. Release acceptance is blocked: intake misses an error-compatibility question, two document openings fail the restricted-reader criterion, a scoring quotation is invalid, the final V6 case is deferred, and some compatible old scores are inconclusive. Overall productivity improvement and human readability are unproven. No merge, tag, release or global installation is part of this delivery.
